items.title: Wayanad: Kerala's first e-waste-free district
items.text: After a three-month collection drive. Next goal: carbon neutrality.

items.title: Kerala's Avalkkoppam ('With Her')
items.text: A Women and Child Development project against domestic and cyber violence.

items.title: Booker Prize 2026: M. John Harrison
items.text: For 'The End of Everything'. At 81, he is the oldest Booker winner.

items.title: India wins SAFF Championship (10th title)
items.text: India beat Pakistan 2–1 in Dhaka on 17 November and became the first team to win three in a row.

items.title: ASEAN–India and Quad summits in Manila
items.text: The 23rd ASEAN–India Summit and the 7th Quad Leaders' Summit were held in Manila, Philippines.

items.title: COP31 climate meeting in Antalya
items.text: Held in Türkiye, 9–20 November 2026.

items.title: Cambridge Word of the Year: 'Human'
items.text: Chosen because of debates about AI and people.

items.text: Recognised for promoting electric vehicles; each winner gets £1 million.

items.title: First Tamil song nominated for a Grammy
items.text: 'Varuvaaiy', based on a Subramania Bharati hymn.

items.title: 8 Next Generation Corvettes for the Navy
items.text: ₹53,866.5 crore contracts: GRSE builds 5, Goa Shipyard builds 3.

items.title: India's first H5N1 vaccine for chickens
items.text: Developed by ICAR-NIHSAD, Bhopal, against bird flu.

items.title: Bulgaria's first elected woman President
items.text: Iliana Iotova won the runoff on 1 November 2026.

items.title: Dhinidhi Desinghu: first Indian Youth Olympic swimming medal
items.text: Bronze in women's 100 m freestyle at Dakar 2026, with a national record.

items.title: Glenn Maxwell retires
items.text: The Australian all-rounder left international cricket on 2 November.

items.title: ₹11,000 crore scheme for building machines
items.text: The Union Cabinet approved a ₹11,000 crore scheme to make construction and infrastructure equipment (like tunnel boring machines) in India. The Ministry of Heavy Industries will run it for eight years from 2026-27.
items.gk: India now imports most tunnel boring machines, mainly from China and Europe.

items.title: US plans 25% tariff on Indian goods
items.text: The US proposed a 25% tariff on Indian goods under Section 301 of its trade law. Among 14 economies, only Vietnam (35%) got a higher rate. India says it has no excess capacity and wants a trade deal with the US.
items.gk: A tariff is a tax on goods coming from another country.

items.title: Retail inflation crosses 6%
items.text: Retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October 2026. This is above the RBI's upper limit of 6% for the first time under the new CPI series (base year 2024). Food inflation was 8.94%.
items.gk: The RBI's inflation target is 4%, with a band of 2% to 6%.

items.title: Spain wins FIFA World Cup 2026
items.text: Spain beat Argentina 1–0 after extra time. Kylian Mbappé won the Golden Boot (10 goals).

items.title: Sarnath becomes India's 45th World Heritage Site
items.text: UNESCO added Sarnath on 25 July 2026 at its meeting in Busan, South Korea.
items.gk: Sarnath (UP): Buddha gave his first sermon here.

items.title: India's first hydrogen train
items.text: Runs on the 89 km Jind–Sonipat route in Haryana (Northern Railway).

items.text: India has 3,682 tigers and 58 tiger reserves.

items.title: New RBI Ombudsman Scheme
items.text: From 1 July 2026, one ombudsman for all bank complaints. Banks must reply in 30 days.

items.title: Rural job guarantee now 125 days
items.text: The VB-G RAM G Act came into force on 1 July 2026, raising guaranteed rural work from 100 to 125 days per household.

items.title: PM-KISAN continues till 2030-31
items.text: Farmers keep getting ₹6,000 a year in three instalments.

items.title: Kamarajar Port reaches 18 m depth
items.text: It is the second Indian port to have an 18-metre draft, after Visakhapatnam.

items.text: MP is the fourth state after Uttarakhand, Gujarat and Assam.

items.title: Seychelles honours Modi

items.text: At Pachpadra: India's first greenfield refinery-cum-petrochemical complex.

items.title: Modi becomes longest-serving elected PM in a row
items.text: On 10 June 2026, Narendra Modi completed 4,399 days in office continuously, passing Jawaharlal Nehru's record.

items.title: RBI keeps repo rate at 5.25%
items.text: The June meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC), led by Governor Sanjay Malhotra, made no change to the repo rate.
items.gk: Repo rate = rate at which RBI lends to banks.

items.title: QS World University Rankings 2027
items.text: India is 5th in the world by number of ranked universities (52). IIT Delhi is the top Indian institute at 118.

items.title: Modi visits Slovakia
items.text: On 15 June 2026, Modi became the first Indian PM to visit Slovakia. He received its highest honour, the Order of the White Double Cross.

items.title: 52nd G7 Summit in France
items.text: Held at Évian-les-Bains, France. India attended the outreach session.
items.gk: G7: USA, UK, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, Canada.

items.title: Kerala launches HAWK
items.text: Kerala started HAWK (Hostile Activity Watch Kernel), India's first wildlife-crime system linked with the courts.

items.title: Kerala: free bus travel for women
items.text: The Priyadarshini scheme gives free KSRTC bus travel to women and transgender persons. Kerala also announced Vision 2031.

items.title: D. K. Shivakumar becomes Karnataka CM
items.text: He became the 18th Chief Minister of Karnataka, after Siddaramaiah.

items.title: Zojila Tunnel breakthrough
items.text: The main tunnel breakthrough gives all-weather road connection between Kashmir and Ladakh.

items.title: India's first Model Border Village
items.text: Chumur in Ladakh became the first Model Border Village under the Vibrant Village Programme.

items.title: Bangladesh's Khalilur Rahman to lead UN General Assembly
items.text: He was elected President of the 81st UNGA session, starting September 2026.

items.title: India's 100th Ramsar Site
items.text: Jai Prakash Narayan Bird Sanctuary (Surha Tal), Uttar Pradesh, was named on World Environment Day (5 June).

items.title: Reliance tops Hurun India 500
items.text: Reliance Industries stays India's most valuable private company. Bajaj Finance entered the top 10 for the first time.
